info.name: SubTrack Microservices API Collection
info.description:
Official Review 2 API Collection for SubTrack (Subscription Lifecycle & Recurring Revenue Management System).

Architectural Entry Point: Spring Cloud API Gateway (Default: http://localhost:8080).

Folders:
1. User Authentication
2. Plan Catalog
3. Admin Plan Management
4. Subscription Lifecycle
5. Payment History
6. Security and Error Handling

item.name: 1. User Authentication
item.description: Registration, login, JWT issuance, profile lookup, and token validation via User Service (routed through API Gateway).

item.name: 6. Security and Error Handling
item.description: Negative security tests: missing/invalid/expired tokens, IDOR/BOLA user data isolation, non-admin role barriers, and blocked internal endpoints.

request.description: Missing Authorization header on protected route is rejected by API Gateway with 401 Unauthorized.
Tampered or invalid JWT signature rejected by API Gateway with 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 6.3 Expired / Invalid-Signature JWT Token (Signature Rejection Test)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 401 Unauthorized (Rejected at Gateway signature/claims check)", function () {

request.description: Tests Gateway rejection of a token with an expired payload but mock signature. Note: Without exposing the private JWT signing secret in the test environment, client-fabricated tokens fail cryptographic signature validation (SignatureException) at the Gateway before claims expiration is evaluated. Both failure modes return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 6.4 Direct External Call to Payment Processor (Blocked)

request.description: Direct external access to POST /api/payments/process is blocked at API Gateway with 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 6.5 Non-Admin Access to Admin Route (Plans All)

request.description: Standard user (role USER) attempting to access admin route /api/plans/all is rejected with 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 6.6 Non-Admin Access to Admin Route (All Users)

request.description: Standard user (role USER) attempting to access /api/users is rejected with 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 6.7 BOLA / IDOR: User Accessing Another User's Profile

request.description: Identity Isolation: User A attempting to inspect profile of User 999999 is blocked with 403 Forbidden.
